description:
Configure the store's transactional email infrastructure. 

1. Go to **Stores > Configuration > General > Store Email Addresses** and update:
   - **Sales Representative**: Name='NestWell Sales', Email='sales@nestwell.local'
   - **Customer Support**: Name='NestWell Help Team', Email='support@nestwell.local'

2. Go to **Stores > Configuration > Sales > Sales Emails**:
   - **Order**: Set 'New Order Confirmation Email Sender' to 'Customer Support'. Add 'manager@nestwell.local' to 'Send Order Email Copy To'.
   - **Invoice**: Set 'Invoice Email Sender' to 'Sales Representative'.

3. Go to **Stores > Configuration > General > Contacts**:
   - Set 'Send Emails To' to 'support@nestwell.local'.
   - Set 'Email Sender' to 'Customer Support'.

Save all configurations. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
